name: despot
what: removes marks that exist on one frame only (film dust and dirt, tape dropouts): each frame is compared with its two neighbours after they are moved onto it (motion compensation), and only where it differs strongly from both is it replaced by their median
when: the frame strip shows marks that are on one frame and gone on the next
script: __vec = MAnalyse(__sup, multi=true, delta=1, blksize=8, overlap=4, truemotion=true, search=5)
softens: anything that really lasts one frame only: fast small objects, rain, sparks, a drawn flash; lower thresholds also touch fast line art
tried_on: written from pinned plugins only (mvtools2, RgTools, masktools2) after the pinned SpotLess script turned out to need a plugin the set does not have. On an owner cartoon cut with five artificial one-frame specks (white and black, 2 to 9 px): mean error at the specks 111 -> 1 levels at every preset, 0.03 % of the pixels of a clean frame changed at most, guard passed. Not yet tried on real film dirt or tape dropouts
